name: Bruised
description: Sore ribs. Nothing a day of quiet will not fix.

name: Sprained Ankle
description: Every road is longer than it looks.

name: Exhausted
description: Swings land late and rewards land light.

name: Poisoned
description: Slow, green, and unpleasant. Treat it properly.

name: Cracked Ribs
description: Serious. The guild surgeon will want paying.

name: Dragonfire Scorch
description: Armour half-melted to skin. This is not a bruise, this is a warning.

name: Void-Touched
description: Something reached back. Part of the wound is not entirely there anymore.

name: Shattered Spirit
description: The body will mend. The nerve to face what did this again will take longer.

name: Marked by the World-Ender
description: A brand that was not there this morning, and will not fade on its own schedule.
